name: scrapingdog-mcp

tools.name: web_scrape
tools.description: General-purpose web scraper. Fetches any URL through Scrapingdog's rotating proxies with optional JavaScript rendering, premium proxies, geo-targeting, and AI-based extraction. Returns the page HTML (or extracted data).

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to scrape.

dynamic.description: Set true to render JavaScript with a headless browser. Costs more credits. (API default: false)

premium.description: Set true to use premium (residential) proxies for hard-to-scrape sites. (API default: false)

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the proxy geo-location (requires premium). (API default: us)

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load before capturing (only with dynamic=true).

session_number.description: Reuse the same proxy IP across requests by passing a stable integer.

ai_query.description: Natural-language instruction to extract specific data from the page via AI.

ai_extract_rules.description: JSON string of field->instruction rules for structured AI extraction.

markdown.description: Return the page content converted to clean markdown instead of raw HTML. (API default: false)

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Scrape real-time Google Search results as structured JSON (organic results, ads, knowledge graph, people-also-ask, etc.).

query.description: Search query. Supports operators like site:, inurl:, intitle:.

results.description: Number of results to return per page.

page.description: Zero-based page number (0 = first page). (API default: 0)

domain.description: Country-specific Google domain (e.g. google.co.uk, google.co.in). (API default: google.com)

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

location.description: Search origin location, ideally at city level. Incompatible with uule.

advance_search.description: Enable rich feature snippets (extra credits). (API default: false)

mob_search.description: Return mobile search results. (API default: false)

tbs.description: Advanced filter for time ranges / verbatim mode.

html.description: Return the full HTML of the Google page instead of parsed JSON. (API default: false)

tools.name: google_maps
tools.description: Scrape local business listings and place details from Google Maps.

ll.description: GPS origin as @latitude,longitude,zoom (e.g. @40.7,-74.0,14z). Required for pagination.

domain.description: Country-specific Google domain (e.g. google.co.uk, google.co.in). (API default: google.com)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

place_id.description: Unique Google Maps place identifier (for place lookups).

data.description: Google Maps 'data' filter string copied from a Maps URL.

page.description: Pagination offset; increment by 20. Requires ll. (API default: 0)

tools.name: google_news
tools.description: Scrape Google News headlines, sources and timestamps.

query.description: Search terms. Supports operators like site: and when:. Cannot combine with *_token params.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

topic_token.description: Topic identifier (World, Business, Technology, ...). Mutually exclusive with query.

publication_token.description: Publisher identifier. Mutually exclusive with query.

section_token.description: Subsection token; only with topic_token or publication_token.

so.description: Sort order (only with story_token): 0 = relevance, 1 = date. (API default: 0)

tools.name: google_trends
tools.description: Track keyword search interest over time and by region via Google Trends.

query.description: Up to 5 comma-separated terms (1 for map-only types); max 100 chars each.

data_type.description: Type of Trends data. (API default: TIMESERIES)

geo.description: Location origin (e.g. US, GB). Defaults to worldwide.

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)
